nodes.summary: Overview of the @waggle/hive-mind-core package — the SQLite + sqlite-vec persistence and retrieval substrate powering Waggle OS memory, listing all modules (FrameStore, HybridSearch, KnowledgeGraph, etc.) and OSS distribution status.
